name: TBG split-aware detail enhancer
plain: A lie based on neighbouring schedule points, on every third or so step: the model runs twice, once at a sigma pulled toward the next (or previous) entry in the full schedule by a chosen amount and once at the true sigma, and the two outputs are mixed. Uses a split-aware step counter to keep the place across split runs.
math:
Only when counter % ceil(steps/3)=0 and counter>2; else D(x,σ).
e>0: σ_m = σ + |e|·(σ_next−σ); out = .7·D(x,σ_m)+.3·D(x,σ).
e<0: σ_m = σ + |e|·(σ_prev−σ); out = .3·D(x,σ_m)+.7·D(x,σ).
label: from code

audit.note: TBG_sampler_split_aware.py:136-150: the lie applies only when counter % ceil(steps/3)==0 and counter>2. On those steps the model runs twice, at the moved σ and the true σ, and the outputs mix 0.7/0.3 for e>0 or 0.3/0.7 for e<0. The entry reads as a single lied call on every step.
